items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Well, it was something on the order of the Suzy Q and trucking, and same way by the palsy, only you would shake your head and shake all over, it's like you had the palsy.

ctx.x: What was the, excuse me for interrupting, what was the Jeep live, Suzy?
Well, it was something on the order of the Suzy Q and trucking, and same way by the palsy, only you would shake your head and shake all over, it's like you had the palsy.
Lee, didn't you also design some clothes for men?
